name: Android Mirror
author: Ayan De
description: Mirror and control your Android phone from the Omarchy bar, or use its camera as a webcam in Meet, Teams and Zoom. USB or Wi-Fi, keyboard and mouse, low latency, no root. A native panel over adb + scrcpy.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: see connected phones, pair over Wi-Fi once, then mirror with keyboard and mouse or turn the phone camera into a webcam in a click.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often `adb devices` is polled while idle. The panel refreshes on open and after every action regardless.

schema.label: adb path
schema.description: Optional. Absolute path to adb; empty means /usr/bin/adb from android-tools. Set this if you use the Android SDK's platform-tools instead.

schema.label: scrcpy path
schema.description: Optional. Absolute path to scrcpy; empty means /usr/bin/scrcpy.

schema.label: Max mirror size (px)
schema.description: Longest side of the mirrored video. Lower is less bandwidth and lower latency over Wi-Fi. 0 keeps the phone's native resolution.

schema.label: Wi-Fi: max mirror size (px)
schema.description: Used instead of the USB size when the phone is connected over Wi-Fi. Smaller means less lag on a weak link.

schema.label: Wi-Fi: video bitrate (Mbps)
schema.description: A 2.4 GHz link realistically carries 10-15 Mbps; leave headroom.

schema.label: Wi-Fi: max fps
schema.description: 0 = uncapped. Audio is always off over Wi-Fi and the phone screen stays on so it does not doze.

schema.label: Turn phone screen off while mirroring
Extra scrcpy arguments
schema.description: Appended verbatim, split on whitespace. e.g. --video-codec=h265 --no-clipboard-autosync

schema.label: Webcam: camera
schema.description: Which phone camera to use as the webcam. The panel's flip button overrides this until the shell restarts.

schema.label: Webcam: capture size
schema.description: 1280x720 is what Meet and Teams send anyway and is easy on Wi-Fi. The size is fixed while the camera runs; change it before starting.

schema.label: Webcam: mirror horizontally
schema.description: Flip the image like a selfie preview. Most conferencing apps already mirror your own preview but send the unmirrored image; leave this off unless text looks wrong to others.

schema.label: Webcam: device node
schema.description: Optional. The v4l2loopback node to write to; empty means /dev/video42, which Set up creates as "Android Mirror Camera". Point this elsewhere if you already have a loopback device.
